checkpoints.note: At the end of a non-multivalued parameter, _parse_param_value forwards the exact characters accumulated from the input in state->buf as buf_cstring(&state->buf). This is the first project statement that creates the vulnerability-relevant structured-value string from attacker input.

The vulnerable type stores fields inline as `vcardstrarray *field[VCARD_MAX_STRUCTURED_FIELDS]` with VCARD_MAX_STRUCTURED_FIELDS set to 20 in vcardstructuredimpl.h. Each ';' separator creates another field and immediately executes `st->field[st->num_fields++] = field;` without any bound check or resizing.
